home.main_paragraph: Lead Data Engineer focused on cloud data platforms, reliable pipelines, and analytics enablement.
home.second_paragraph: Strong problem-solving skills and a Kaizen philosophy. Avid reader, passionate about sustainability and technology.

items.title: Lead Data Engineer
description: Leading the structuring and industrialization of Emotors' cloud data platform across Azure, Databricks, and Azure Data Factory.
Validated a Databricks-on-AWS proof of concept and contributed to building the official target platform on Azure.
Designed robust, idempotent ingestion and transformation pipelines with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Improved ingestion patterns with Azure Data Factory and supported on-premise to cloud migration initiatives.
Drove Databricks cost and compute optimization while aligning data engineering standards with BI and business needs.

items.title: Data Engineer
description: Designed and optimized data models and databases to make operational data accessible across teams.
Built data and BI tools that transformed fragmented information into reliable KPIs and actionable insights.
Helped establish a stronger data culture in an industrial environment of 200+ employees.
Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into maintainable analytics solutions.

items.title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyzed large data sets to define and monitor sales and operations KPIs.
Developed and maintained dashboards used to track business performance.
Applied machine learning models to forecast sales seasonality and improve planning accuracy.
Turned exploratory analysis into useful reporting outputs for business teams.
